en: Old Woman
Every Pokémon has a power hidden inside it. Nobody can see it, but it is there.
I've a game for you. I hold a coin in one hand, and you guess which.
Guess right three times running, and you'll have something worth having.
Shall we play?
Which hand holds the coin?
Right
Left
Right you are! Again, now. Which hand?
Right
Left
Right again! One more. Which hand?
Right
Left
Three in a row! You see what others miss. This is yours.
Hidden Power takes its type from the Pokémon that uses it. Every one of them is different.
Wrong hand, I'm afraid. Come and try again another time.
Suit yourself. My hands will keep.
Old Man
A Pokémon that can fight in its sleep is never idle. Shall I teach one of yours Sleep Talk?
Very well. Which one?
{wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...
{wearer} learned {thing}!
Pair Sleep Talk with Rest, and a Pokémon heals and fights at once. Zzz...
Ah. Then I'll go back to my nap.
An Egg sleeps already, but it can't learn anything yet.
Hmm, that one can't learn Sleep Talk.
That one already knows {thing}.
{forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that.
